questions.q:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decided which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Some mobile are instruments,

All instruments are heavy items.

I. Some mobiles are heavy items.

II. No mobile is a heavy item.

III. Some heavy items are instruments.
options: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions III and either conclusion I or II follow
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,



Conclusions:

I. Some mobiles are heavy items. → True (Some mobile are instruments and all instruments are heavy items)

II. No mobile is a heavy item. → False (conclusion I is true)

III. Some heavy items are instruments. → True (all instruments are heavy items)

Hence, only conclusion I and III follows.

questions.q: If sec θ – tan θ = P, then cosec θ = ?
options: 1−P2P2+1​
1+P21−P2​
1−P22P​
1+P22P​
questions.solution:
Short trick∶

⇒ sec θ – tan θ = P

Putting θ = 45°

⇒ P = (√2 – 1)

∴ cosec45° = √2

Check option (1)

⇒ 1−P2P2+1​ = 1−(2​−1)2(2​−1)2+1​ = sqrt 2 (Satisfied)

Detailed solution∶

⇒ sec θ – tan θ = P ----(1)

As we know, sec²θ – tan²θ = 1

⇒ (sec θ – tan θ) (sec θ + tan θ) = 1

⇒ sec θ + tan θ = 1/P ----(2)

Adding equation (1) and equation (2)

⇒ 2sec θ = P + 1/P

⇒ sec θ = (P² + 1)/2P

⇒ cos θ = 2P/(P² + 1)

We know, sin²θ = 1 – cos²θ

⇒ sin²θ = 1 – [(2P)²/(P² + 1)²]

⇒ sin²θ = [(P² + 1)² – (2P)²] / (P² + 1)²

⇒ sin²θ = (P⁴ + 1 + 2P² – 4P²) / (P² + 1)²

⇒ sin²θ = (P⁴ + 1 – 2P²) / (P² + 1)²

⇒ sin θ = (1 – P²) / (P² + 1)

⇒ cosec θ = (P² + 1) / (1 – P²)
7e

questions.q: What will be the compound interest (nearest to integer) on a sum of Rs. 25,000 for 2 years at 12% p.a., if the interest is compounded 8 monthly?
questions.solution:
Short trick∶

⇒ 25000 × (8/100) = 2000 × 3 = 6,000

⇒ 2000 × (8/100) = 160 × 3 = 480

⇒ 160 × (8/100) = 12.8

∴ Total interest = 6000 + 480 + 12.8 = Rs. 6492.8

Detailed solution∶

Total sum = Rs. 25000

Rate for 12 months = 12%

⇒ Rate for 8 months = 8% and Time (24 months)/8 = 3

⇒ Amount = 25000 × (27/25) × (27/25) × (27/25) = Rs. 31,492.8

∴ Required Interest = 31,492.8 – 25,000 = Rs. 6,492.8

questions.q: The value of θ, when √3cos θ + sin θ = 1 (0° ≤ θ ≤ 90°), is∶
questions.solution:
Short trick∶

Go through the options,

√3cosθ + sinθ = 1

Put θ = 90°

⇒ √3 × 0 + 1 = 1

⇒ 1 = 1 (Satisfied)

Detailed solution∶

√3cosθ + sinθ = 1

⇒ √3cosθ = 1 – sinθ

Squaring both the sides

⇒ 3cos²θ = 1 + sin²θ – 2sinθ

⇒ 3 – 3sin²θ = 1 + sin²θ – 2sinθ

⇒ 2sin²θ – sinθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 2sin²θ – 2sinθ + sinθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 2sinθ(sinθ – 1) + 1(sinθ – 1) = 0

⇒ (2sinθ + 1) (sinθ – 1) = 0

⇒ sinθ = 1 or -1/2

∴ θ = 90°

questions.q: A man purchases 100 copies of a book from the publisher and gets a discount of 25%. He buys 50 copies from a retailer at a discount of 10%. He got an overall discount of∶
questions.solution:
Short trick∶

⇒ Ratio of 100 copies and 50 copies = 2 ∶ 1

∴ Required discount = [(2 × 25%) + (1 × 10%)] / (2 + 1) = 20%

Detailed solution∶

Let MP of 1 copy of a book be Rs 1.

MP of 150 copies of a book = Rs. 150

SP of 100 copies of a book = 100 × [3/4] = Rs. 75

SP of 50 copies of a book = 50 × [9/10] = Rs. 45

Total SP = 75 + 45 = Rs. 120

Total MP = Rs. 150

∴ Overall discount = [(150 – 120)/150] × 100 = 20%

questions.solution:
Short Trick∶

Suppose a = 1, b = 2 and c = 4,

ab + bc + ca = 1 × 2 + 2 × 4 + 4 × 1 = 2 + 8 + 4 = 14

Detailed solution∶

As we know, (x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2xy + 2yz + 2zx

Given a² + b² + c² = 21 and a + b + c = 7

⇒ (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 7² = 21 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 49 – 21 = 28

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 14

questions.q: Three numbers are such that if the average of any two of them is added to the third number, the sums obtained are 168, 174 and 180 respectively. What is the average of the original three numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the three number be a, b and c.

According to the question

⇒ [(a + b)/2] + c = 168

⇒ a + b + 2c = 336 ----(1)

⇒ [(b + c)/2] + a = 174

⇒ b + c + 2a = 348 ----(2)

⇒ [(a + c)/2] + b = 180

⇒ a + c + 2b = 360 ----(3)

Adding equation (1), equation (2) and equation (3)

⇒ 4(a + b + c) = 1044

⇒ a + b + c = 261

∴ Average of all the three numbers = 261/3 = 87

questions.q: The ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C is 7 ∶ 5 ∶ 4. Working together, they can finish a work in 35 days. A and B work together for 28 days. The remaining work will be completed (in days) by C alone∶
questions.solution:
The ratio of efficiency of A, B and C = 7 ∶ 5 ∶ 4

Total work = (7 + 5 + 4) × 35 = 560

Work completed by A and B in 28 days = (7 + 5) × 28 = 336

Remain work = 560 – 336 = 224

∴ Remain work will be completed by C alone = 224/4 = 56

questions.q: If x + y = 1 and xy(xy – 2) = 12, then the value of x⁴ + y⁴ is∶
questions.solution:
Given x + y = 1 and xy(xy – 2) = 12

⇒ (x + y)² = 1²

⇒ x² + y² + 2xy = 1

⇒ (x² + y²)² = (1 – 2xy)²

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ + 2x²y² = 1 + 4x²y² – 4xy

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ = 1 + 2x²y² – 4xy

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ = 1 + 2xy(xy – 2)

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ = 1 + 2 × 12

⇒ x⁴ + y⁴ = 25

questions.q: If x is added to each of 12, 28, 21 and 45, the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 3) and (4x + 1)?
questions.solution:
According to the question

⇒ (12 + x) / (28 + x) = (21 + x) / (45 + x)

Using Componendo or Dividendo

⇒ (12 + x + 28 + x) / (12 + x – 28 – x) = (21 + x + 45 + x) / (21 + x – 45 – x)

⇒ (40 + 2x) / (-16) = (66 + 2x) / (-24)

⇒ x = 6

Mean proportional between (x + 3) and (4x + 1)

⇒ √[(6 + 3) × (4 × 6 + 1)] = √(9 × 25) = 15

questions.q: If an 8-digit number 179x091y is divisible by 88, the value of (5x – 8y) is∶
questions.solution:
8 digit number 179x091y is divisible by 88 means that the number is divisible by 11 and 8 both.

⇒ 91y is divisible by 8 if we put y = 2 as the last three digits are divisible by 8.

⇒ 179x0912 is divisible by 11 if we put x = 4 as the difference between the sum of odd digit place and the sum of the even digit place is 11.

⇒ 5x – 8y = 5 × 4 – 8 × 2 = 4

questions.q: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in which ∠A = 67° and ∠B = 92°. What is the difference between the measures of ∠C and ∠D?
questions.solution:
Short trick∶

Required difference = ∠B – ∠C = 92° – 67° = 25°

Detailed solution∶

As we know, the sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°.

⇒ ∠A + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠C = 180° – 67° = 113°

⇒ ∠B + ∠D = 180°

⇒ ∠D = 180° – 92° = 88°

⇒ ∠C – ∠D = 113° – 88° = 25°

questions.q:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

The crop was adversely affected by the inadequate rainfall.
options: The inadequate rainfall was adversely affecting the crop.
The adversely rainfall has affected the inadequate crop.
The inadequate crop adversely affected the rainfall.
The inadequate rainfall adversely affected the crop.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'The inadequate rainfall adversely affected the crop.'

Key Points

• The given sentence is in a passive voice form, hence we need to convert it into an active voice form.

• Find the subject (The crop) and object (the inadequate rainfall. ) of the sentence and exchange their places.

• The given sentence is in the simple past tense. The active verb form for simple past is:

• Subject + V2 + object.

• So, 'was adversely affected' changes to adversely affected'.

• At last line up the remaining part.

Following these steps, we finally get- The inadequate rainfall adversely affected the crop.​

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2.

A cartographer is a person that makes maps.

Up until the 18th century, maps were often decorated with fanciful beasts and monsters, at the expense of accurate details about places. French mapmakers of the 1700s and 1800s encouraged the use of more scientific methods in the art they called "cartographie." The French word *cartographie* (the science of making maps), from which we get our English word "cartography," was created from "carte," meaning "*map*," and "-*graphie*," meaning "representation by." Around the same time, we adopted "cartography" in the mid-19th century, we also created our word for a mapmaker, "cartographer.”

questions.q:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. And 844 million don’t have access to clean water close to home, according to the latest report by WaterAid.

B. Around 4 billion people in the world live in physically water-scarce areas.

C. It is because globally we use six times as much water today as we did 100 years ago.

D. The world’s water crisis is getting worse.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4: BADC

We can gather from the above sentences that the paragraph is about the global water crisis.

Sentence B comes 1st as a paragraph always starts with a general statement and B serves as the introductory sentence of the para which introduces us to the topic.

Sentence A comes 2nd as it sheds more light on the issue mentioned in sentence B.

Sentence D follows A as it gives us a gist of the topic mentioned in sentences B and A.

Sentence C follows B as it provides a reason for the water crisis getting worse- an issue mentioned in sentence D.

*Hence the correct order is BADC*.
